buffer_size.label: Audio buffer size
buffer_size.description:
Controls how much audio is buffered in memory. A larger buffer improves playback stability and seeking but uses more memory.

- **Minimal**: Small buffer, recommended for memory-constrained devices.
- **Balanced**: Moderate buffer, good balance for most systems.
- **Maximum**: Large buffer, best performance for systems with plenty of memory.

allow_crossfade_same_album.label: Allow crossfade between tracks from the same album
allow_crossfade_same_album.description: Enabling this option allows for crossfading between tracks that are part of the same album.

smart_fades_log_level.label: Smart Fades Log level
smart_fades_log_level.description: Log level for the Smart Fades mixer and analyzer.
